items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: His wife, John Hammond came over, and said, “I never heard him play like that.”

ctx.x: You want to talk about that for a moment?

I put it on my horn, on my saxophone case, I-W-S. Well he told you to say that. Well Benny used to pick on everybody you know. He picked on everybody but me, let’s put it that way. And I-W-S was “I Won’t Snap.” I don’t care what you say, I won’t snap you know. And when people used to get mad at him, I’d go, “I-W-S.” He’d go, “Okay.” That’s where that came from. I won’t snap. Which I did one time. No I didn’t snap, but Benny used to pick on everybody you know. So I got fed up. I went in his dressing room one time…
Wow. He just needed someone to tell him—
